facility.name: Giggles and Smiles Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2000 10TH ST, FLORESVILLE, TX, 78114

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Field Trips - Signed Permission: A child participated in a field trip without the operation obtaining the required signed permission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Field Trips - Signed Permission (26 TAC §746.3001(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant did not have a current feeding schedule at review.     *Parent emailed the feeding schedule within an hour*
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The lightning in the classroom was insufficient to see the children's faces.    This was corrected when the hallway light was turned on, allowing light to enter the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: There were forty-two children to one caregiver during nap time.    Note this was corrected when the twelve children that were awake were transitioned to another room to be supervised by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Caregiver did not know many children they were responsible for during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: A child had a serious self-inflicted injury in a sensitive area of the body and parent was not notified immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Outlet in the 18-24 month classroom was uncovered.    This was corrected when the director covered the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: There were two caregiver caring for 6 infants and 31 children ages 18 months and up.     This was corrected when caregivers transitioned their student to their individual classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: The children were restricted in the highchair for 19 minutes.    This was corrected when the caregivers removed the children from the highchairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Children were not fastened with the safety straps on the high chairs.     This was corrected when the caregiver strapped the children with the safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids: The caregiver did not wash her hands after wiping the child's nose.     This was corrected when the caregiver was guided to wash her hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Infants were grouped with children of 18 month difference.     This was corrected when the caregivers transitioned the children to their rooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Children were eating cheerios directly from the table.    This was corrected when caregiver threw away the cheerios and provided new cheerios on top of a napkin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were a total of 7 children to one caregiver however the specified age group is17 months therefore caregiver was over ratio by 2 children.    Note: This was corrected when another caregiver joined the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Cleaned and Sanitized Between Each Use: Two sippy cups appeared to have some sort of bacteria (black dots) inside the cup.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Cleaned and Sanitized Between Each Use (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(B))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A person with a pending eligibility status was observed in direct contact with children. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver left the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink: Due to construction, the infant class  temporarily moved to a room without a sink. This was corrected at inspection when the class relocated into a room with a sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: The daily report for a 17-month-old shows the infant was changed once at 10:59 am on 7/9/2024 resulting in a severe rash. No other diaper changes were logged for the child that day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A classroom had 11 children between 10 months - 22 months with one caregiver during naptime. The specified age group was 12-17 months with the caregiver being over ratio by 5 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver stepped out of the classroom to answer the door leaving the children unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: A ball play item on the play structure had several broken balls.    Corrected at inspection: The balls were taken off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A classroom had 11 children between 10 months - 22 months with one caregiver during naptime. The specified age group was 12-17 months with the caregiver being over ratio by 5 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths: The caregiver failed to ensure a used diaper wipe was discarded after use and accidentally left it in a child's clean diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths (26 TAC §746.3501(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver without a completed background check was observed to be in a classroom.    **This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver left the premises.**
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: There was a broken plastic portal in the outdoor climbing equipment which had a sharp hole in it that presented a hazard for entrapment.    This was corrected at inspection when the broken portal was removed from the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Two infant caregivers did not have proof of training available to review in the required topics of Shaken Baby Syndrome, SIDS, and Safe Sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child's record was missing the required Emergency Care Authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: There was one television in the infant room that was not anchored or secured. There was one television in the after school room that was not anchored or secured.      This was corrected at inspection when the director had the televisions removed from the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: There was no soap or paper towels available in the boy's and girl's toddler restrooms.     This was corrected at inspection when the soap and paper towels were stocked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: At the time of inspection several staff in direct care of a group of children were using their cell phones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Three employees were working in the center without a current background check and current FBI fingerprints.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Two caregivers in the infant room were not certified in SIDS and Shaken Baby Training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Provide Access to Children's Records - During Hours of Operation: Based on the information gathered, the center director took all the children's records away from the center to keep them safe from another person in the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Access to Children's Records - During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §746.601(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: Two caregivers in the infant room were not certified in CPR and First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on the observations made during the inspection, there were 6 children ages 12 to 18months old with one caregiver.   There were 23 three and four year old children with one caregiver.   This was corrected when a second caregiver arrived in the classroom.   This was corrected when the classes were split and a second caregiver took the other class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infant feeding schedules were expired at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: At the time of inspection the caregvier in the 12 to 17 month old classroom had 6 children.  This was corrected when the director took the oldest child to the next room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: At the time of inspection one infant with a wedge under the mattress without a sleep exception form on file.    The wedge was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infant feeding schedules were expired at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The pea gravel and the mulch around the fall zones of the play structure was not maintained at its proper depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: At the time of inspection there were not any current activity plans posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The fire drill has not been completed since September.  This was corrected when a fire drill was completed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
